description.narrative:
Project Outcome (Strong) - Stakeholder effects access to finance for SMEs: The Project will increase access to finance to SMEs in Guatemala, including WSMEs. The country's SME sector is underserved by financial institutions, especially the women-owned segment. The Project will endow the client with a stronger capital structure which will enable it to expand its lending capacity and provide sustained financing for projects that drive inclusive economic growth.
Market Creation (Strong) - Resilience: This transaction will support the market's ability to withstand negative shocks, such as a macroeconomic downturn, liquidity squeeze, or natural disasters, by strengthening the loss-absorbing capacity of the country's largest bank through a Tier 2 subordinated loan. To measure progress against this outcome, IFC will track the capital buffer of tier 1 banks in Guatemala.

The proposed investment consists of an up to 10.25-year subordinated unsecured financing package for US$850 million to Banco Industrial, S.A. (theBank or Banco Industrial). This financing package is composed of: (i) an up to US$100.0 million subordinated loan for IFCs own account; and (ii) a B1 loan of up to US$750.0 million (together, the C/B Loan project) funded through a public issuance of notes in the international capital markets through a 144A/Reg S format and listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
